_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Technical Manual Cost Report
summary: Provides the Government with the necessary budget information that program managers can use for planning, evaluation, and future TM development cost estimating.
use_relationship:
The Technical Manual (TM) Cost Report provides the Government with the necessary budget information that program managers can use for planning, evaluation, and future TM development cost estimating.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instruction for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.

This data item shall not be procured when this information is provided by any other report supplied by the same contractor.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The TM Cost Report shall be presented in the contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The TM Cost Report shall contain the charges for each new TM or revision, as applicable. The cost information for TMs shall be limited to the effort and material needed to produce the manual from source data. The report shall also include the following:

children.title: Name and address of contractor and contract number.
Applicable Technical Manual Contract Requirement (TMCR) number(s), TM identification number(s), and title(s) of the TM(s) covered within the report.
Document Type Definition (DTD) Public Identifier(s) used to develop the TM(s) covered by the report.
Total number of pages or screens of text in the TM(s).
Total number of illustrations (including multiple sheets) in the TM(s).
Total number of direct man-hours expended for each labor category.
Listing of labor categories used and the associated labor rates.
Listing and cost of non-labor expenditures.
Total cost of contractor quality assurance (QA) efforts, broken out by support of Government QA functions and contractor TMQA program efforts.

preparation_instructions.title: The report shall contain any research
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall contain any research and liaison cost(s) to obtain basic source data for new TMs and revisions. Research, experimental, or development work that led to such basic data required for the development of an end item shall not be included. TM cost (information) shall not be duplicated in relation to other contractor charges associated with the other basic engineering data or logistic management information already being collected.
